Name: Bearded Bachelors
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Modular Options: Customize facial hair for all bachelors year-round[/*]
[*]Harvey's Mustaches: Rotate annually through different styles[/*]
[*]Seasonal Realism: Default settings, beards grow in fall/winter, disappear in spring/summer[/*]
[*]Character Sprites: Optional bearded character sprites for all bachelors[/*]
[*]Festival Support: Option to disable beards during festivals.[/*]
[/list]
This mod gives the six eligible bachelors seasonal beards by default:
[list]
[*][b]Fall:[/b] Groomed beards[/*]
[*][b]Winter:[/b] Bushy beards[/*]
[*][b]Spring & Summer:[/b] Clean-shaven (back to their usual looks) ... well, except Harvey.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus[/b]: Harvey gets his own twist! Each spring when he tries out a different mustache style, just for fun.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Year-Round Support:[/b] You can adjust, add or remove the beards for each bachelor for all four seasons using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].[/*]
[/list]
I hope you enjoy these seasonal beards!

[b][color=#c9daf8]Supporting Cancer Research ✧[/color][/b]
This mod is inspired by the beard-growing traditions I grew up with. Every winter, it seemed like someone back home was letting their beard grow out. Later, the [i]No Shave November[/i] movement gave that tradition a new layer of meaning by connecting it to cancer awareness and research.

After losing someone recently to cancer and my own family having faced this battle as well, I wanted to add this small reminder of resilience and community into the game while also raising awareness for cancer research.

If you enjoy this mod and would like to support cancer research, please consider donating to:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.cancer.org/donate.html]American Cancer Society[/url] - Leading cancer research and patient support[/*]
[*][url=https://www.cancerresearch.org/donate]Cancer Research Institute[/url] - Immunotherapy research and treatment[/*]
[*][url=https://www.cancer.gov/about-nci/budget/fact-book/cancer-research-funding]National Cancer Institute[/url] - Federal cancer research funding[/*]
[/list]
Every donation, no matter the size, helps fund the research that saves lives. Thank you for considering supporting this important cause.

[i]Note: This mod is completely free and will always remain free. Donations to cancer research are entirely optional and go directly to the organizations listed above, not to the mod author.[/i]
